name: Nemotron-4 4B Instruct

lifecycle.note: Weights remain downloadable from NVIDIA's Hugging Face organisation as Nemotron-Mini-4B-Instruct. The NVIDIA API catalog set a deprecation date for the hosted endpoint (see milestones).

released.note: Announced at Gamescom 2024; the blog of that day says the model is available as an NVIDIA NIM. The Hugging Face weights carry no stated date.

date.note: The notice, as seen on 2026-10-01, says the API will be deprecated on 08/25/2026. Applies to the hosted API only, not to the downloadable weights.

sources.locator: NVIDIA ACE introduces an SLM purpose-built for roleplaying

relations.note: The card says it is a fine-tuned version of Minitron-4B-Base, which was pruned and distilled from Nemotron-4 15B.

summary.text: Nemotron-4 4B Instruct is a small language model from NVIDIA, announced on 20 August 2024 for NVIDIA ACE, its game-character technology, as an NVIDIA NIM for cloud and on-device use. NVIDIA says it was distilled from Nemotron-4 15B and tuned for role-play, retrieval-augmented generation and function calling; weights followed on Hugging Face as Nemotron-Mini-4B-Instruct.

changes.text: About 4 billion parameters by name, distilled from the 15-billion-parameter Nemotron-4 15B.
Pruned, distilled and INT4-quantised by NVIDIA for on-device inference using about 2 GB of VRAM.
Instruction-tuned for function calling, role-play and retrieval-augmented generation; Nemotron-4 15B was a base model described in a report only.

parameters.note: As given in NVIDIA's model name; neither source states a separate parameter count.

sources.locator: NVIDIA ACE introduces an SLM purpose-built for roleplaying

access.note: Offered as an NVIDIA NIM for cloud and on-device deployment (GeForce RTX PCs), hosted at build.nvidia.com, and later as weights on Hugging Face.

notes: Introduced in August 2024 as Nemotron-4 4B Instruct, part of NVIDIA ACE for game characters; the Hugging Face repository, the API catalog and the NGC resource use the name Nemotron-Mini-4B-Instruct, and the card links the ACE blog. The API id nvidia/nemotron-mini-4b-instruct differs from the repository name only in case. The intermediate Minitron-4B-Base model has no record. A later Hindi model (Nemotron-4-Mini-Hindi-4B) builds on the same base and is not covered here.
